title: Heliocentric Astrology (1921 Edition)
author: Holmes W. Merton
description: Heliocentric Astrology, or Essentials of Astronomy and Solar Mentality, with Tables of Ephemeris, by Holmes W. Merton (writing as Yarmo Vedra), here in the 1921 edition (published by David McKay, Philadelphia). Merton advocates an astrology based on the heliocentric (Sun-centred) positions of the planets rather than the traditional geocentric chart, arguing that it reflects the true astronomical order and the solar source of life and mind. The book explains basic astronomy, the planets' heliocentric motions and their characteristics, the zodiac signs and their influence on character and talents ('solar mentality'), and how to set up and read a heliocentric chart using the included ephemeris tables. It is a pioneering work of the heliocentric astrology movement and a companion to the 1910 edition also in the library.
